title: A project's evidence kit (plan E5): .sdlc/adapters/evidence/<project id>/kit.json
description: Reusable, tested step helpers for declarative cases: the accounts of the reusable test env, how to log in, and named helpers such as `flag` (turn a feature on or off). A step file can only use what the kit declares; when a case needs a helper the kit lacks, the run refuses before it starts and reflect proposes adding it.

command.description: a shell command run in the evidence worktree with the env loaded

testedBy.description: where the helper is tested (a case id or a test file)
